draft.title: Baked Sausages with Apples Sheet Pan Dinner
draft.description: Baked Sausages with Apples Sheet Pan Dinner - these pork sausages are perfectly baked together with apples, fingerling potatoes, baby carrots and lots of fresh herbs, all in one pan making it super easy for cleanup and ready in just 35 minutes!
draft.nutrition_text: Serving: 1 serving · Calories: 681 kcal · Fat: 41 g · Saturated fat: 11 g · Cholesterol: 81 mg · Sodium: 1066 mg · Carbohydrates: 59 g · Fiber: 8 g · Sugar: 23 g · Protein: 21 g
ingredients: 2 large apples (cored and cut into cubes, I used Granny Smith)
steps: In a large bowl combine the apple cubes, fingerling potatoes, baby carrots, onion, sage and rosemary. Drizzle the honey and olive oil over, season generously with salt and pepper then toss really well so that everything.
Arrange the veggies and apples in a large shallow roasting pan. Arrange the sausages in and around the vegetables.
Bake for 30 minutes or until golden and cooked through.
